# iPhone USB GPS

> macOS command-line tool that sets a simulated (fake) iPhone GPS location over USB using DVT LocationSimulation, with place search through Apple Maps. Commands: `gps-set`, `gps-status`, `gps-reset`. Targets iOS 17.4+ and macOS 26+. No sudo, no permanent service. Includes a Codex skill.

Install: `git clone https://github.com/sicaboy/iphone-usb-gps.git && cd iphone-usb-gps && ./install.sh`

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/sicaboy/iphone-usb-gps/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, Developer Mode troubleshooting and FAQ
- [简体中文 README](https://github.com/sicaboy/iphone-usb-gps/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Codex skill](https://github.com/sicaboy/iphone-usb-gps/blob/main/skills/iphone-usb-gps/SKILL.md): lets Codex run the same commands
